source.data: Lithuanian national LiDAR (Lidar_DR_LT), LKS-94 sheet 76/32 (VILNIUS centras); source files dated 2025-12-04..2025-12-04, classified by NZT (TerraScan), LAS point format 6
source.owner: Nacionaline zemes tarnyba prie Aplinkos ministerijos (NZT)
source.licence: CC BY 4.0 (open data per NZT Order D1-395)
source.attribution: © Nacionalinė žemės tarnyba prie Aplinkos ministerijos, 2025
source.method: ground = 10th pct of class-2 z within 3 m outside footprint (else 2 m grid); eave = 25th pct, ridge = 95th pct, max = max of class-6 z inside footprint; n = class-6 count

vertical_datum: LAS07 (Lithuanian Height System, normal heights, EVRF2007 realisation) - as NZT delivers its LiDAR; Potree conversion dropped the LAS CRS records, not re-verified
units: metres, absolute heights (subtract ground for heights above ground)
